messages:
Ava (People Ops): Heads-up — we're consolidating the travel expense and remote-work policies into a single 'Work & Travel' appendix. Need a quick pulse on training assignments and a CSV export of people who still owe the updated policy ack.
Leah M.: 👍 what fields do you need in the export?
Ava (People Ops): name, email, manager, team, country, ack_status, ack_ts. Preferably manager email too.
Tom H.: I can run a query but need the list of teams included. Do we include contractors?
Ava (People Ops): Include FT, PT, and contractors for now. We'll filter later for benefits-specific comms.
Marcus (Recruiting): For hiring ops we should also mark candidates in 30-day onboarding who've seen the policy doc — adds another column 'onboard_seen'.
Ava (People Ops): Good call, @Marcus. Add 'onboard_seen' boolean.
Leah M.: I'll pull the export. Running from the HR dashboard now. If anyone wants to validate column names, speak up.
hr-bot: export-job-17823 queued by Leah M. ETA ~2m
Tom H.: Thx. Also flagging country-specific snippets for EU/UK — we can't send relocation language to EU folks without counsel sign-off.
Ava (People Ops): Noted. We'll set country filters before the mail merge. Leah, can you add a country_code column?
Leah M.: Yup — adding country_code and manager_email. Running SQL:```SELECT name,email,manager,manager_email,team,country_code,ack_status,ack_ts,onboard_seen FROM people WHERE active=1;```
Marcus (Recruiting): Should we include a column for hiring-rep so we can route follow-ups?
Ava (People Ops): Add 'hiring_rep' too. Good for the people still in onboarding.
Leah M.: Export finished. Attached: work-travel-policy-export-1942000000.csv (uploaded to #people-ops-files). :file_folder:
Tom H.: Quick QA: sampled 50 rows, ack_status values show 'pending', 'acknowledged', 'declined' — good. A few contractors without manager_email.
Ava (People Ops): We'll follow up on missing manager_email. Marcus, can recruiting fill those for contractors?
Marcus (Recruiting): On it — will push a quick cleanup ticket and update the CSV by EOD.
Leah M.: For the training assignments: do we want a targeted 20-min microtraining for managers + a separate 10-min ack refresher for ICs?
Ava (People Ops): Yes. Managers: mandatory microtraining + quiz. ICs: email + two-minute explainer video + ack. We'll track completion via LMS which writes back ack_status.
Tom H.: Timeline?
Ava (People Ops): Draft of microtraining content by Thu; pilot with eng manager cohort Fri; company rollout next Tue.
Leah M.: I'll import the CSV to LMS mapping columns: email -> user_id, ack_status -> completion, onboard_seen -> tags.
hr-bot: lms-import-2145 started by Leah M.
Marcus (Recruiting): Quick hiring ops note — for offers going out next week, include a short note about policy consolidation so new hires don't get confused. I'll update offer template.
Ava (People Ops): Thanks. Action items:
- Leah: upload final CSV to LMS and to s3://redwood-people/policy_exports/work-travel-1942000000.csv (due EOD)
- Marcus: contractor manager_email cleanup + update offer template (due tomorrow)
- Tom: QA country filters + confirm counsel-approved snippets for EU/UK (due Thu)
- Ava: draft microtraining + quiz + pilot coordination (due Thu)
Leah M.: CSV uploaded to S3 and LMS import finished. Link: https://s3.redwood.internal/policy_exports/work-travel-1942000000.csv :white_check_mark:
Tom H.: Verified EU filter; counsel provided redlined snippet, added to the doc. :eyes:
Marcus (Recruiting): Contractor emails updated, re-uploaded.
Ava (People Ops): Great — I’ll schedule the pilot with the eng managers. Thanks, team. :tada:
